# LSR-2 bill of materials and cost (generated by scripts/bom.py)

Source: `bom/bom_lsr2.yaml`. Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina (BricoHams). Every price and every bought-part mass is **VERIFY** (generic values, local quotes). Fabricated masses are read from `build/lsr2_build_report.json` (finished masses); the script checks their total within 1 % against reported volume x density. Goal: light and cheap, so the "Cheaper" column names an alternative where one exists.

Plate cost is the cheaper of full sheet and cut-to-size blank plus cutting (LSR2_MATERIALS); cast parts include foundry metal; shafts include bar and turning. Aluminium plates and cast parts mass 1864 g, shafts 1742 g.

## Totals (VERIFY)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Fabricated parts | 71 € / 3.61 kg |
| Bought parts, fasteners, electronics | 317 € / 8.52 kg (estimated masses) |
| PLA patterns, core box and prototype | 28 € (1.40 kg PLA, not in the mass) |
| **Total, one rotator without mast, antenna and cable run** | **417 €** |
| **Mass, rotator and electronics** | **12.12 kg** |

By group: Motion 146 €, Bearings 20 €, Cross boom 11 €, Hardware 20 €, Fasteners 6 €, Corrosion 6 €, Electronics 88 €, Sensors 4 €, Wiring 17 €, fabricated 71 €, PLA 28 €.

The two NMRV030 gearboxes and the two NEMA23 motors dominate the mass and the cost of the bought parts; see [LSR2_MATERIALS](LSR2_MATERIALS.md) for the cost model and [LSR2_ASSEMBLY](LSR2_ASSEMBLY.md) for the build.
